app.name: Hello World
app.localOnly: All data stored on this device
app.error: Something went wrong. Your data is safe — try again.

errors.url: That doesn't look like a web link (it should start with http:// or https://).
errors.diaryTooLong: Diary entries can be up to 10,000 characters.
errors.duplicateConcept: You already have “{{name}}” — pick it from the list.

mood.label: How are you feeling?
mood.before: Before you start — how are you feeling?
mood.after: Session done. How do you feel now?

difficulty.def1: Uses exactly one concept directly. 3–10 lines of code.
difficulty.def2: One or two concepts, straightforward input, no edge-case traps.
difficulty.def3: Two or three concepts together; one small edge case.
difficulty.def4: Needs a small insight or careful edge-case handling; still only known concepts.
difficulty.def5: Codeforces Div. 3 A/B flavor: short story, precise I/O format, multiple test cases, constraints.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Hello World
onboarding.languagesHint: Pick one or more. Star the one you're focusing on.
onboarding.otherPlaceholder: Type a language and press Enter
onboarding.goalHint: Small and steady beats big and rare. You can change this any time.
onboarding.boundaryHint: Late-night sessions count toward the previous day. With 04:00, coding at 1:30 am still counts for yesterday.
onboarding.letterPrompt: Why are you learning to code?
onboarding.letterHint: Optional. It stays sealed for 30 days, then you can open it.
onboarding.coachMark: Press Start when you sit down to code. The timer keeps going even if you close the app.

today.title: Today
today.empty: Nothing logged yet. Start a session or add what you learned.
today.longSessionBody: This session has been running for {{duration}}. Did you forget to stop it?
today.longSessionFix: End it at a different time
today.staleBody: Keep it, or end it at the time you stopped?
today.learnedPlaceholder: e.g. for loops, list slicing, f-strings…
today.notePlaceholder: Explain it like you'd tell a friend
today.noProblems: No problems yet. Even one attempt counts.
today.diaryPlaceholder: What was hard? What clicked? No one else will read this.
today.dayClosed: Day closed: {{time}}, {{concepts}} concepts, {{problems}} problems. See you tomorrow.

compare.harder: You're being harder on yourself than your log. {{summary}} is a solid day.
compare.agree: Your rating and your log agree.
compare.higher: Felt good! Your log shows mostly {{dominant}}; a practice problem tomorrow will lock it in.

usefulness.shadowingCapped: Capped at 60: lots of time but no problems attempted yet.

problem.title: Title
problem.hintRecorded: Revealing the hint is noted, and that's fine — hints are how people learn.
problem.revealWarning: Revealing before you solve it marks this as “Solved with help”. That still counts.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noInsight: Insights appear as you log. Close a few days and patterns will show up here.

charts.notEnough: Log a few more days to see this chart.
charts.moodUsefulSummary: Mood went from {{moodFrom}} to {{moodTo}} and usefulness from {{useFrom}} to {{useTo}} over the last {{days}} days.
charts.timeSummary: You logged {{total}} over the last {{days}} days; the busiest day was {{best}}.
charts.heatmapSummary: {{active}} active days out of {{days}}, {{total}} in total.
charts.moodBeforeAfterSummary: On average, mood changed by {{delta}} points from before to after sessions.
charts.usefulByHourSummary: Your most useful hour starts at {{hour}}:00 (average {{avg}}).
charts.speed: Average minutes per problem by difficulty
charts.speedSummary: Tracking solve time for {{levels}} difficulty levels across {{weeks}} weeks.
charts.timeVsAttemptsSummary: {{shadow}} of {{days}} days had 90+ minutes and no problems attempted.

insights.title: Insights
insights.none: No insights yet. They show up as you close days — nothing needs to be perfect.
insights.comeback: On day {{day_number}} you felt {{moodLabel}} about {{concept}}: “{{snippet}}”. {{days_later}} days later you solved {{count}} {{concept}} problems.
insights.been_here_before: Day {{day_number}} felt like this too. You wrote: “{{snippet}}”. {{days_later}} days later you solved {{count}} {{concept}} problems. This feeling passes.
insights.shadowing_warning: You put in {{minutes}} minutes today but didn't try any problems. Watching helps; doing makes it stick. Try one warm-up tomorrow.
insights.forgotten_concept: You learned {{concept}} {{days}} days ago and haven't practiced it since. A quick warm-up would lock it in.
insights.best_time: Your most useful sessions start between {{hour_start}}:00 and {{hour_end}}:00 (average {{avg}} vs {{overall_avg}} overall).
insights.getting_faster: You're getting faster: level {{level}} problems take {{percent}}% less time than four weeks ago.
insights.mood_lift: Coding lifts your mood: on average you finish sessions {{delta}} points happier than you started.

first_milestones.concepts: {{value}} concepts learned. Look how far you've come.
first_milestones.problems: {{value}} problems solved on your own. That's real practice.
first_milestones.problems_with_help: {{value}} problems solved with help. Asking for help is how everyone learns.
first_milestones.hours: {{value}} hours of focused learning. Keep going.

insights.noLetters: No letters yet. Write one to the person you'll be in a month.

notebook.title: Notebook
notebook.pickDay: Pick a day to read it.
notebook.nothingLogged: Nothing was logged this day. That's okay.

practice.title: Practice
practice.context: Turn what you learned into problems
practice.noConcepts: No concepts in this range. Log what you learned on Today first.
practice.copyModeHint: Free: paste into ChatGPT or Gemini
practice.noProvider: No model configured yet. Add one in Settings → AI models.
practice.strugglesHint: Adds concepts you tagged Stuck or Revisit later.
practice.promptCopied: Prompt copied. Paste it into your chatbot, then paste the answer back here.
practice.generating: Generating… this can take a minute
practice.pasteHint: Paste the whole reply. We'll find the JSON and check it.
practice.invalid: We couldn't read that as problems. That happens — chatbots add extra text sometimes.
practice.fixupCopied: Fix-up prompt copied. Paste it into the same chat.
practice.queueEmpty: Your queue is empty. Generate a few problems to get started.
practice.showPrompt: Show the exact prompt that will be sent

library.title: Library
library.context: Links, notes and files you learn from
library.dropHere: Drop files to copy them into your library
library.dropHint: Drag files here — they're copied, your originals stay put.
library.empty: Your library is empty. Paste a link or drop a file to begin.

roadmaps.title: Roadmaps
roadmaps.context: Your path, one node at a time
roadmaps.empty: No roadmaps yet. Create one, or import a roadmap file you downloaded.
roadmaps.dragHandle: Reorder {{title}}. Use arrow keys: up/down to move, right to nest, left to un-nest.
roadmaps.linkHint: When a linked concept is logged, the node moves to Learning automatically.
roadmaps.importHint: Imports our roadmap.v1.json format, or a roadmap file you downloaded yourself (e.g. from roadmap.sh). Attribution is kept.
roadmaps.deleteConfirm: Delete this roadmap? This can't be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.aiIntro: Copy-prompt mode always works and is free. Add a model to generate problems directly. Ollama runs fully on your computer.
settings.label: Label
settings.apiKeyHint: Stored in your system keychain. It is never shown again.
settings.allowDiary: Allow sending diary text to AI
settings.allowDiaryHint: Off by default. When off, your diary never leaves this device.
settings.restoreConfirm: Restore this backup? Your current data is backed up first.
settings.deleteAllHint: This removes your database, library and backups from this device. Type DELETE to confirm.
settings.reminderHint: A gentle system notification at this time.
settings.reminderBody: Time for a little coding? Even ten minutes counts.
settings.licenses: Built with Tauri, React, Recharts, Lucide and IBM Plex / Fraunces fonts (OFL). Open-source licenses are included with the app.
settings.diagnosticsHint: Logs and version info only — never your diary or keys.
